Name: Cheese Artistry Infused - The Forest and the Harvest
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[font=Courier New][b][color=#ea9999][size=5]Cheese Artistry Infused[/size][/color][/b]
[b][size=4]Supports Cornucopia, Wildflour, SVE, RSV.[/size][/b][/font]


[font=Courier New][b][color=#ea9999][size=5]New ingredients & items[/size][/color]
[size=4]1. [color=#ffd966]Roasted Cashew Nuts[/color] : Slow-roasted cashews with a golden finish and a mellow, buttery sweetness.[/size]
[size=4]2. [color=#ffd966]Roasted Chestnut[/color] : A chestnut roasted until golden, with a soft, fluffy texture and natural sweetness. Its warm aroma recalls an autumn forest.[/size]
[size=4]3. [color=#ffd966]Roasted Hazelnut[/color] : A carefully roasted hazelnut with a deep, toasted aroma and a hint of sweetness.[/size]
[size=4]4. [color=#ffd966]Roasted Pistachio[/color] : A fragrant roasted pistachio. Beneath its shell, the vivid green kernel offers delicate sweetness and a rich, satisfying flavor.[/size]
[size=4]5. [color=#ffd966]Roasted Sunflower Seeds[/color] : Gently roasted sunflower seeds with a light crunch and a simple, pleasantly toasted flavor. [/size][/b][/font]
[font=Courier New][b][size=4]6. [color=#ffd966]Roasted Pecan[/color] : Slowly roasted pecans with a rich, buttery flavor and a hint of natural sweetness. [/size][/b][/font]



[font=Courier New][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color]
[size=4]Download and unzip the file.[/size]
[size=4]Place the extracted folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. [/size][/b][/font]
